events.name: AI Tinkerers Atlanta – April Meetup
events.description: The monthly AI Tinkerers Atlanta in-person meetup for active builders, engineers, and AI practitioners featuring live code demos of LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI—no slides, no pitches. Attendance is screened to maintain a high-quality technical environment for early-stage discovery and peer learning.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – Community Day & Startup Showcase
events.description: Community Day kicks off Atlanta AI Week with a free, public Startup Showcase from 3–5 PM featuring execution-ready AI startups presenting live demos and pitches. A Community Happy Hour follows from 5–7 PM, open to the public with RSVP. This is the on-ramp to Atlanta's largest AI conference week.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI Leadership Summit
events.description: The flagship day of Atlanta AI Week featuring the AI Leadership Summit with mainstage keynotes, 13 content tracks, 100+ sessions, workshops, panels, fireside chats, and VIP roundtables. Produced by the Enterprise Technology Association, the event brings together enterprise leaders, founders, practitioners, and investors focused on real-world AI adoption and implementation across industries.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI for Business Summit
events.description: Day three of Atlanta AI Week features the AI for Business Summit, Women in AI & Tech Breakfast, and additional breakout sessions and networking. Programming spans three venues across Buckhead—Atlanta Tech Village, Roam Garage, and TechRise Atlanta—all within walking distance.

events.name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days | Atlanta
events.address: 200 17th Street NW, South Building – MPR 2.2D (2nd Floor)
events.description: A community-led developer event focused on AI-assisted coding with GitHub Copilot, featuring real AI workflows, live demos, and a hands-on lab at Microsoft Atlantic Yards. Developers of all experience levels explore practical workflows, real-world use cases, and AI-assisted coding techniques including Agent Mode and VS Code integrations.

events.name: Chapter Meeting: "AI & Digital Transformation"
events.description: A chapter meeting hosted by TAG Georgia at Microsoft's Atlanta office focused on AI and digital transformation. Attendees connect with technology leaders and peers to explore how AI is driving business transformation across Georgia's enterprise ecosystem.

events.name: From SEO to GEO: A Hands-on Workshop to Show Up in AI Answers
events.description: A morning hands-on workshop focused on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)—the strategy of getting discovered in AI-powered search answers like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Marketers and content teams learn practical techniques to adapt their content strategy for the AI answer era.

events.name: 8th Marketing AI Pulse
events.description: The 8th edition of the flagship Marketing AI Pulse quarterly event brings together 150+ marketing leaders, agencies, martech providers, and AI practitioners for an afternoon of panels, fireside chats, and an AI tools partner expo. Sessions this edition feature speakers from Google Cloud, Adobe, and Robert Half covering AI playbooks for marketing and GTM teams, AI-assisted creativity, and AI's impact on marketing talent.

events.name: The Jury Experience – Death by AI: Will Atlanta Deliver Justice?
events.description: An immersive, theatrical panel experience placing attendees in the role of jurors to deliberate real questions of AI accountability, ethics, and governance. This thought-provoking community event explores the societal and legal implications of AI through a unique storytelling and debate format.

events.name: AI Tinkerers Atlanta – May Meetup
events.description: The monthly AI Tinkerers Atlanta in-person meetup featuring curated live code demos from local builders working on LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI. Events are limited to 50–60 screened active builders to foster meaningful technical exchange and early-stage collaboration.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (May)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup featuring deep-dive tech talks on AI, GenAI, LLMs, and AI agents, followed by food, drinks, and networking with speakers and fellow developers. The meetup draws 8,000+ local AI developers and regularly features speakers from leading tech companies and startups.

events.name: AI Tinkerers Atlanta – June Meetup
events.description: Monthly in-person AI Tinkerers Atlanta meetup for serious builders, featuring code-first demos of foundation models, AI agents, and generative AI systems. A hackathon event is also planned for 2026—check atlanta.aitinkerers.org for the latest date announcement.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (June)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup for developers and practitioners, covering the latest in GenAI, LLMs, AI agents, and machine learning through hands-on tech talks, code labs, and structured networking. Collaboration with ATDC and leading Atlanta tech companies brings expert speakers to each session.

events.name: The AI Collective Atlanta | Northside Networking w/ Trivia
events.description: An informal AI networking meetup at Roswell Junction hosted by The AI Collective Atlanta chapter, featuring AI trivia and open conversation for professionals working in or exploring AI. This northside event is designed to bring together the Buckhead, Sandy Springs, Dunwoody, and Roswell AI community.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (July)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup featuring deep-dive tech talks on AI, GenAI, LLMs, and Agents with hands-on code lab experiences and networking. The event brings together a community of 8,000+ AI developers in Atlanta supported by sponsors who provide food, drinks, and venue.

events.name: The AI Collective ATL Summer Social
events.description: A free summer social meetup hosted by The AI Collective Atlanta chapter at Mutation Brewing Company in Sandy Springs, just north of I-285 on Roswell Road with free parking. AI professionals and enthusiasts gather to connect, share insights on the latest in AI, and build community across Atlanta's northside tech ecosystem.

events.name: RenderATL 2026 – AI Summit Included
events.description: RenderATL 2026 is a two-day premier technology conference for professional continuing education, uniting 10,000+ developers, engineers, designers, and tech leaders with 120+ speakers and workshops across AI, machine learning, web frameworks, and leadership. New for 2026, every RenderATL ticket includes admission to the Atlanta Tech Week A.I. Summit, with dedicated AI programming, sessions, and immersive product demos across 250,000+ sq ft.

events.name: RenderATL 2026 – Day 2 & OpenJS Summit
events.description: Day two of RenderATL 2026 features continued AI and machine learning sessions, the OpenJS Summit spotlighting the future of JavaScript with AI-enabled development and production lessons, and RenderFEST—an outdoor festival with food trucks and live entertainment included with your ticket.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (August)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup featuring deep-dive tech talks on GenAI, LLMs, and AI agents with practical code lab experiences and structured networking. The Alpharetta venue at Improving hosts Atlanta's largest recurring AI developer meetup community.

events.name: The AI Collective ATL | End of Summer Social @ Bucket Shop Cafe
events.description: Join AI pros and enthusiasts for The AI Collective Atlanta chapter's End of Summer Social at The Bucket Shop Cafe in Buckhead, across from Lenox Mall. Hosted by Atlanta Chapter co-leader Mark Michelson, this free social event is open to professionals working in AI or interested in entering the industry—a chance to connect, share ideas, and discuss the latest in AI.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (September)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup featuring deep-dive tech talks, code labs, and networking on the latest in GenAI, LLMs, and AI agents. Speakers from innovative companies and successful startups share practical experience and implementation practices.

events.name: AICamp Atlanta – Monthly AI Meetup (October)
events.description: AICamp's monthly in-person Atlanta AI meetup for developers and practitioners featuring deep-dive tech talks, workshops, and networking on AI, GenAI, LLMs, and agents. The community of 8,000+ Atlanta AI developers gathers at Improving's Alpharetta office for its regular learning and networking session.
